 Mr. Paramananda Jyotish, Advocate

 State of Odisha and others ....

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Parties
 Mr. Swayambhu Mishra,
 Additional Standing Counsel
 Coram:
 Justice K.R. Mohapatra
 Justice Savitri Ratho
 Order
Order No. 03.12.2025
 04. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Mr. Mishra, learned Additional Standing Counsel submits that much before filing of the writ petition, the petition under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for brevity, "the Act") has already been disposed of.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Suppressing the said fact, the Petitioner has filed this writ application.

He further submits that he has already received instruction in the matter along with relevant documents and prays for a short adjournment to file affidavit enclosing the order passed under Section 64 of the Act.

3. Let the affidavit be filed within a period of two weeks hence, serving copy thereof on Mr. Jyotish,
learned counsel for the Petitioner, who shall take instruction on the same after receiving the copy.
4. Put up this matter on 12th January, 2026 along with affidavit.
 (K.R. Mohapatra)
 Judge  (Savitri Ratho)
